programmes.d: Hobie befriends a boy who has moved to California to live with his father after his mother's death.
Mitch helps a woman he calls “The Mermaid” who turns out to be the wife of a crime boss.
The Baywatch team is put on high alert when thousands of reckless treasure hunters storm the beach.
When the hot Santa Ana winds move in from the desert, things start heating up on the Baywatch beach.
A lifeguard-turned-hovercraft expert introduces new technology to the Baywatch team.
Matt and Hobie rescue a young boy who is being harassed by a thug and take care of him.
Joey joins Mitch and Hobie in decorating for Christmas. Father Ryan falls in love with CJ.
Logan's visa is soon to expire. Can he get his green card before he gets sent back to Australia?
Mitch's ex-wife flies in for a weekend visit and informs Mitch she is taking Hobie to Ohio.
A dramatic plane crash finds Hobie and his mother trapped in a rapidly flooding fuselage.
Stephanie is kidnapped by an eco-terrorist. The Baywatch team must rescue her and save the day.
Mitch proposes to Tracy, but the happy moment is short-lived as she reveals she is terminal ill.
Mitch is still mourning Tracy’s death, so Hobie seeks help from a radio show to help Mitch recover.
Mitch receives a mysterious package his father had put together before he died.
Andy, an old friend of Mitch, visits Baywatch to complete four days of lifeguard service.
Matt and CJ stumble upon a homeless man who shockingly turns out to be someone they know very well.
When testing out a new flying machine, Mitch spots a makeshift raft with a stranded woman in it.
Prominent British businessman Richard Branson visits Baywatch to perform several risky stunts.
Hobie’s idol comes to the beach, but Mitch is furious he turns out to have some questionable morals.
Mitch considers a new career working with Garner as a private eye. Logan cheats on Caroline again.
When a crippled oil rig sinks and floods with water, the team begins a desperate rescue effort.
Kaye asks Hobie to volunteer at a school for young blind children.
Cody and Neely rescue two surfers that fall ill due to a highly polluted beach.
Mitch's mother arrives in town and, after some strange occurrences, he insists she see a doctor.
Stephanie, CJ, and Caroline go on a girls-only junior lifeguard trip to Catalina.
Hobie's new friend Isaac’s risky behavior causes problems for the lifeguards.
Logan borrows Cody's car without permission and has an accident, then lies to the police.
Matt returns to Baywatch and ends up trapped on a yacht with Neely and a group of ruthless pirates.
Logan and Caroline’s relationship hits a new low when Caroline returns his engagement ring.
Caroline blames herself for a teen's death in a fiery nighttime boating accident and gets PTSD.
